definitions: If a flame or light blows out, it is put out by the wind or by someone blowing.
If a tyre blows out, it bursts suddenly.
To celebrate something by spending a lot of money.
To defeat an opponent very easily in a game or contest.
examples: My front tyre blew out on the motorway.
They blew out on a lavish party for their anniversary.
Our team blew out the competition in the final.
